name: Orphaned surveyor
description: An audit machine that counts allocations as deliveries. It still treats an unpaid household as an empty address. Circles at range, fires three-shot bursts and fan volleys, and predicts your route with staggered bombs. Sidestep the beams; change direction when bombs lock on.

name: Wirejack
description: An autonomous salvage machine that treats public equipment as scrap. Flanks runners, lunges down marked lanes, chains two blade sweeps, and throws a spread of scrap grenades at distant targets. Dodge sideways through a lunge, then punish its recovery. The second blade swing reaches farther.

name: Debt warden
description: An armored collector enforcing Continuance’s inherited claims. Cleaves the ground ahead, charges through marked lanes, sends out two shockwave rings, and brackets distant runners with artillery. Get behind a cleave, move into a ring’s clear center, and leave shell markers before impact.
